episodes.title: Daddy's Truck
episodes.summary: In need of money after damaging their dad's truck, Sterling and Blair team up with veteran bounty hunter Bowser to help capture a frenemy's father.

episodes.title: What's a Jennings
episodes.summary: As Sterling scrambles to foil a blackmail attempt and Blair tests her feelings for Jennings, they assist Bowser in hunting down a counterfeiter.

episodes.title: This Must Be How Dumb Kids Feel
episodes.summary: In between tracking an elusive bail jumper, Blair goes on a date with Miles, and Sterling searches for friends beyond her Fellowship group.

episodes.title: Basically Pluto
episodes.summary: Sterling and Blair can't escape relationship drama when they use the well-heeled guests at their mom's book club party as bait to catch a scammer.

episodes.title: Death Is Bad
episodes.summary: While helping Bowser pursue a wily exotic dancer, the twins process a teacher's untimely passing by making major relationship decisions.

episodes.title: Master Debater
episodes.summary: Sterling sows some wild oats by checking out the competition at a debate tournament, and a suspicious Blair enlists Miles to help spy on her mom.

episodes.title: Cleave or Whatever
episodes.summary: Blair digs for clues about her mom's past, Sterling partners with April on a school project, and both twins get an eyeful during a stakeout with Bowser.

episodes.title: From Basic to Telenovela
episodes.summary: Blair and Sterling's double life catches up with them when their respective romantic plans interfere with Bowser's hunt for a drug-trafficking DJ.

episodes.title: Our Ham Is Good
episodes.summary: The twins take off on a road trip to uncover their mom's secrets but wind up revealing some of their own. Bowser reluctantly joins forces with Terrance.

episodes.title: Something Sour Patch
episodes.summary: After demanding the truth from their mom, the twins face a troubling night filled with heartbreak, hardened criminals and shocking revelations.
